data.title: Agentic programs: an emerging form of scientific software in computational materials science
data.description: arXiv:2609.00795v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Computational materials science has traditionally delegated algorithmic tasks to computers while leaving scientific judgments to humans. In this Perspective, we argue that agent harnesses built on large language models (LLMs) enable an emerging form of scientific software, agentic programs, integrating deterministic algorithms with bounded LLM-based judgment, task-specific verification, episodic maturation, and complete delegation. We illustrate these characteristics through DeMARS, which constructs atomistic models from experimentally measured disordered crystal structures.
data.author: Yunsung Lim, Haekwan Jeon, Jaesun Kim, Jisu Kim, Seungwu Han
